text: Mbileeɓe ɓen wi'ani Fir'awna: "Men ɓurnataa jokkugol ma -an Fir'awna- e dow jokkugol koo ko ari e amen immorde e Aayeeje ɓannguɗe ɗen, men ɓurnataa ma e dow Alla On Taguɗo men, waɗu e amen ko waɗataa, a maraa laamu e hoore amen si wanaa e ɗam ngurnadam re'ayɗan ɗoo, laamu maaɗa ngun iway, ngu lanna.
